turns.content:
[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" Tushar ho sakta hai, kyunki Sameer ne college group mein ek reel share kiya tha jismein unka business dikhaya gaya tha, aur Tushar ne uspar comment karke Sameer ke business ki tarakki ka zikr kiya tha. Iske alawa, Faisal ne bhi Sameer ke business ko lekar ek joke banaya tha college group mein. Yeh sab milakar lagta hai ki Tushar hi woh "dost" ho sakta hai jiska zikr Sameer ne Faisal se kiya tha. Third-person frame ka istemal karke Sameer ne apne "dost" ke liye job opportunity ke liye puchha, jisse yeh baat private rahe.

2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath aik mazaakiya andaaz mein baat ki, jisme Faisal ne Sameer ko "sponsor" kaha aur unke business ki tarakki par mazak kiya. Iske baad Faisal ne Sameer ko DM mein CV bhejne ka kahaa, lekin Sameer ne koi jawab nahi diya. Faisal ka thumbs-up aur joke, aur phir teen din ki silence, yeh darshaate hain ki Faisal ne shayad apni pehli baat mein seriousness dikhayi thi, lekin jab Sameer ne jawab nahi diya to Faisal ne phir se follow up kiya. 

3. Faisal ko ab yeh DM bhejna chahiye: "Bhai, koi update? HR ab tak wait kar rahe hain. Agar CV abhi tak nahi bhej sakte, toh main unhe directly follow up kar sakta hoon." Isse Faisal apni baat ko fir se rakhta hai aur apne agle steps ke liye raah khuli rakhta hai bina kuch admit karaye.
